SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, medium shot. the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard) sits on the caramel corduroy sofa holding a black smartphone in both hands in his lap, looking down at it. The phone's back faces the camera.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image, no zoom, no pan, no handheld sway. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, window dark navy, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.5s: he looks up from the phone toward the upper left (the kitchen island, off-screen). 0.5s to 2.0s: he asks his line. 2.0s to 3.0s: he waits, eyebrows raised.

PERFORMANCE
Hopeful, a little lost. No exaggerated acting, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. The man keeps the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No new people enter. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The man says in natural native Korean, low and dry, hopeful, asking, rising at the end: "그럼 대답은요?" He says only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural delivery, visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
